editable_rules.atomicity_rule: Keep one parent SRS when multiple Source-backed atomic facts belong to the same coherent function/responsibility/state relationship. Split SRS only when obligations are functionally distinct or need independent ownership/allocation/change/release control. Preserve atomic facts under the parent and use them as Test Conditions for E2E test decomposition; fact count alone never forces SRS splitting.
editable_rules.scenario_grouping: ALIRA judges scenario grouping from user goal/context; requirement count is not pre-fixed.
editable_rules.gap_handling: Do not fill missing facts. Record missing/ambiguous information in clarification_needed and gaps.
editable_rules.source_traceability_level: Every requirement must include document + location + source_text.
editable_rules.reference_usage: Use examples for format/pattern only; never copy their domain facts into the current document.
editable_rules.functional_nonfunctional_classification: Use source-explicit classification first. If absent, classify functional vs non-functional by requirement obligation and mark classification_basis as rule-based inference. If ambiguous, use review needed.
editable_rules.trigger_precondition_separation: Separate activation trigger from preconditions when source supports the distinction; do not invent missing conditions.
editable_rules.evaluation_exception_rule: Do not invent evaluation methods or exception conditions. If not source-supported, leave empty so exporters display 입력문서에서 확인되지 않음.
editable_rules.related_artifact_rule: Record source-backed tables/figures/diagrams/signals as related artifacts. Do not generate new factual diagrams/graphs in V0.33.
editable_rules.controller_software_behavior_inference: If Source names a controller/ECU-like actor and explicitly states executable software-like behavior, allow Main SWE.1 and SWE.6 candidate promotion as SW_BEHAVIOR_INFERRED_REVIEW_REQUIRED even without a literal SW keyword. Do not override high-confidence non-software domains; human allocation review remains required.
editable_rules.guide_person_policy_question_mode: V0.78 generates cross-document human policy questions from repeated review patterns. Answers are not automatically persisted or applied in V0.78; individual SRS approval prompts should be avoided when a stable policy-family question can represent them.

user_notes: You may edit this JSON between runs.
Changing these rules changes ALIRA judgment behavior without changing Python code.
Protected invariants are stored separately and cannot be overridden by this file.
